legal_description_paragraphs: ALL AND SINGULAR that certain piece, parcel or lot of land, with improvements thereon, being designated as the “Remaining Portion of Lot Three (3), Block Fifty-One A (51-A), Hotel Section,” on a map prepared for Strand Services, Inc. by Robert L. Bellamy and Associates, Engineers and Surveyors, dated October 2, 1975 and recorded October 15, 1975 in Plat Book 58 at Page 237, Horry County Register of Deeds, reference to which is craved as forming a part of these presents.

TOGETHER WITH an easement over a twenty-two foot (22′) wide area as shown on the aforesaid map for purposes of ingress and egress for the benefit of the owners of Lot 3, their heirs, successors and assigns, appurtenant to the premises.
SUBJECT to all easements, restrictions, rights-of-way, and matters of record affecting the subject property.

BEING the same property conveyed to MB APTS 1A LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, by Limited Warranty Deed of SNP of MB, LLC, dated March 4, 2022 and recorded March 29, 2022 in Deed Book 4532 at Page 3029, Horry County Register of Deeds.
requirements: The Proposed Insured must notify the Company in writing of the name of any party not referred to in this Commitment who will obtain an interest in the Land or who will make a loan on the Land. The Company may then make additional Requirements or Exceptions.
Pay the agreed amount for the estate or interest to be insured.
Pay the premiums, fees, and charges for the Policy to the Company.

We must be furnished with a copy of SCID 3601 executed pursuant to Section 38-75-960 S.C. Code of Laws 1976, as amended, and an executed Notice of Availability of Title Insurance pursuant to S.C. Insurance Department Regulation R-69-18, Vol. 25A of S.C. Code of Laws 1976, as amended.

Seller’s/Owner’s Affidavit & Indemnity executed by current owner (MB APTS 1A LLC) on a form to be supplied by the Company stating that there have been no improvements to the land within the past 90 days which could give rise to a construction lien and that there are no accounts or claims pending and unpaid which could constitute a lien against the land. The affidavit shall also state that affiant has no knowledge of any natural person or legal entity who has or could have a claim of right, interest, or lien adverse to the Insured.
Receipt of the acknowledged First American Title Insurance Company Privacy Policy.
Documents satisfactory to the Company that convey the Title or create the Mortgage to be insured, or both, must be properly authorized, executed, delivered, and recorded in the Public Records.

Warranty Deed from MB APTS 1A LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, to _______________ conveying the land described in Schedule A, duly executed, acknowledged, and delivered for recording, with SC Affidavit of True Consideration (SC Code § 12-24-70) attached; accompanied by satisfactory evidence of authority for the Delaware LLC to convey (i.e., certified LLC resolution, operating agreement excerpt, and a Delaware good-standing certificate).

Payoff, satisfaction and release of record of that certain Mortgage, Assignment of Leases and Rents, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing from MB APTS 1A LLC to ReadyCap Commercial, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, in the original principal amount of $20,415,000.00, dated March 10, 2022 and recorded April 8, 2022 in Mortgage Book 6544 at Page 1393, Horry County Register of Deeds (Loan No. 202024884); together with the companion Assignment of Leases and Rents from MB APTS 1A LLC to ReadyCap Commercial, LLC dated March 10, 2022 and recorded April 8, 2022 in Deed Book 4537 at Page 2280, Horry County Register of Deeds.

Payment in full of all delinquent Horry County ad valorem taxes and personal property taxes assessed against the Land and against MB APTS 1A LLC, including without limitation: (i) 2025 Real Estate tax, Notice No. 262256253, $20,454.30 UNPAID; (ii) 2025 Personal Property tax, Notice No. 036786254, $1,146.56 UNPAID; (iii) 2024 Personal Property tax, Notice No. 037860244, $1,146.56 UNPAID; (iv) 2023 Personal Property tax, Notice No. 037524234, $1,230.33 UNPAID; and (v) 2022 Personal Property tax, Notice No. 054490224, $75.19 UNPAID (assessed to SNP of MB, LLC), together with any accrued penalty and interest; aggregate approximately $24,052.94.

Pending Litigation — Sparkle Habersham v. Emma Brown, Richard Brown, and MB APTS 1A LLC d/b/a Sea Bee Apartments, Horry County Court of Common Pleas, Case No. 2025-CP-26-06732: Default has been entered against MB APTS 1A LLC by Order of the Clerk of Court dated February 24, 2026 (Order for Entry of Default). The Company requires (a) a current docket report from the Horry County Clerk of Court reflecting no money judgment, enrolled judgment, lis pendens, attachment, or adverse order against MB APTS 1A LLC or its interest in the Land arising from said action; (b) satisfaction, dismissal, or other conclusive disposition of the action (including any damages inquiry following the entry of default) in a form acceptable to the Company, or, in the alternative, a litigation indemnity and/or closing escrow holdback on terms acceptable to the Company; and (c) Seller’s affidavit of no adverse money judgment or lien against MB APTS 1A LLC arising from or related to Case No. 2025-CP-26-06732.

UCC Review — The Company requires evidence satisfactory to it regarding the status of (i) UCC Financing Statement recorded May 12, 2023 in Book 6675 at Page 1067 (Debtor: MB APTS 1A LLC; Secured Party: ReadyCap Commercial, LLC), as assigned by UCC Amendment recorded December 8, 2025 in Book 6980 at Page 1034 to ReadyCap Warehouse Financing LLC / Ready Capital Subsidiary REIT II LLC, and as terminated of record by UCC-3 Termination recorded January 8, 2026 in Book 6991 at Page 1527 (marked “CANCELLED OF RECORD”); and (ii) UCC Financing Statement recorded April 2, 2026 in Book 7022 at Page 3360 (Debtor: MB APTS 1A LLC; Secured Party: BRMK Management SPE JP, LLC) — the Company requires confirmation as to whether a corresponding BRMK mortgage or other security instrument has been recorded or will be recorded contemporaneously with the proposed transaction, and, to the extent the BRMK UCC covers fixtures or personal property on the Land, a termination or partial release of record as to the Land.

Receipt of satisfactory evidence of the current status of the Sea Bee Apartments commercial operation at the Land, including: (a) copy of the business license; (b) any short-term or long-term lease agreements affecting the Land; and (c) rent roll.
The Company may make other requirements or exceptions upon its review of the proposed documents creating the estate or interest to be insured or otherwise ascertaining details of the transaction.
exceptions: Any defect, lien, encumbrance, adverse claim, or other matter that appears for the first time in the Public Records or is created, attaches, or is disclosed between the Commitment Date and the date on which all of the Schedule B, Part I—Requirements are met.

(a) Taxes or assessments that are not shown as existing liens by the records of any taxing authority that levies taxes or assessments on real property or by the Public Records; (b) proceedings by a public agency that may result in taxes or assessments, or notices of such proceedings, whether or not shown by the records of such agency or by the Public Records.

Any facts, rights, interests, or claims that are not shown by the Public Records but that could be ascertained by an inspection of the Land or that may be asserted by persons in possession of the Land.
Easements, liens or encumbrances, or claims thereof, not shown by the Public Records.

Any encroachment, encumbrance, violation, variation, or adverse circumstance affecting the Title that would be disclosed by an accurate and complete land survey of the Land and not shown by the Public Records.
Any mineral or mineral rights leased, granted, or retained by current or prior owners.
NOTE: Exceptions Nos. 1 through 6 above will be deleted upon issuance of the Loan Policy only.

Pending Litigation — Sparkle Habersham v. Emma Brown, Richard Brown, and MB APTS 1A LLC d/b/a Sea Bee Apartments, in the Court of Common Pleas for Horry County, Fifteenth Judicial Circuit, Case No. 2025-CP-26-06732. MB APTS 1A LLC (the record owner of the Land) is named as a defendant and Default has been entered against it by Order of the Clerk of Court dated February 24, 2026. The action arises out of a dog-bite incident occurring July 1, 2025 at the Sea Bee Apartments, 304 2nd Avenue North, Myrtle Beach, SC. Plaintiff asserts four causes of action against MB APTS 1A LLC (strict liability under S.C. Code § 47-3-110 and negligence, inter alia) and seeks actual and punitive damages in an amount in excess of $100,000. The Policy will not insure against loss or damage arising out of or in connection with said pending action, including any money judgment hereafter entered against MB APTS 1A LLC and enrolled in Horry County, or any lien, attachment, or other encumbrance that may hereafter attach to its interest in the Land as a result thereof. This Exception shall be removed upon satisfactory disposition of the action and compliance with the corresponding Schedule B, Part I Requirement.
Rights of tenants and occupants in possession of the Land under unrecorded leases or occupancy agreements (including, without limitation, tenants of the Sea Bee Apartments).
Any lien, or right to a lien, for services, labor, or material heretofore or hereafter furnished, imposed by law and not shown in the Public Records.
Rights or interests of adjoining owners in and relating to any party wall, shared structure, or common facility located along or adjacent to the boundaries of the Land.
